rule.description: What a server must meet to be listed

registry_name.description: The server's name in the official MCP Registry (safety check 2)

version.description: The latest version, which checks 1, 3, 4 and 5 read

integrity.description: npm dist.integrity, or sha256 of the PyPI file read (a wheel when there is one)

packages.description: The package versions the checks read

commit.description: Commit of the default branch whose files were read

content_hash.description: sha256 over "<path>\0<sha256 of file>\n" for the files of `git archive <commit>`, paths sorted (symlinks and .git, node_modules, .venv, venv, __pycache__ folders left out); null for results read before 2026-10-14

url.description: The project document, with every check and its evidence

source_url.description: Canonical page to cite and link

checked_at.description: Date of the GitHub check behind the facts; null when the latest check missed the repo
